name: protocol-studio
description: Orchestrator for Protocol Studio (formerly Protocol Playground v2). Deliberately NOT an npm workspace - each sub-repo installs from its own package-lock.json so dependency versions never drift. `npm run dev` runs the full local stack (Redis + mock service + backend + Vite, plus the local workbench: Mongo, automation-db, registry stub, recorder, report service and the ONIX api-service) via scripts/dev.js. The frontend consumes the LOCAL automation-mock-runner-lib, installed by scripts/sync-local-lib.js.

scripts.setup: npm run prepare:install && npm run prepare:env && npm run install:lib && npm run install:be && npm run install:ui && npm run install:mock && npm run sync:lib && npm run verify:lib
scripts.build:ui: npm run verify:lib && npm --prefix automation-frontend/frontend run build
scripts.build: npm run sync:lib && npm run build:be && npm --prefix automation-frontend/frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:lib && npm run test:be && npm run test:ui && npm run test:mock
